payload.body_they: {{Name}} needs enough freedom at home to decide how their space, time, access, and responsibilities are shared. They can care deeply about where they came from without wanting to reproduce the household or family rules they inherited. The complication is changing everything before identifying the exact freedom they were missing. Home works better when they can change what no longer fits while still building enough consistency to have something they can rely on.
